findings.title: restored data was not visible in the running UI after a successful import until a manual reload
findings.mechanism: was: applyPlan() never reloaded the tasks/lists store and the importer announced no bulk change; fixed: applyImport/restoreSnapshot/wipe fire the data-replaced seam (src/portability/side-effects.ts) which reloads the store + settings in the acting tab and announces change:"all" to peer tabs (ADR-003 Decision 8.1)
